info.title: Yamba Message Service API
info.description: Coordination between shipper and carrier (chantier F, D61). One conversation per deal, opened at acceptance. The MEETING is an object (proposed / accepted), not a thread of messages; the thread carries the rest. The delivery code never travels (D43): a message containing it is refused. Contact details are detected and flagged, never blocked. The counterpart's phone number opens at most 2 hours before the pickup meeting, and every reveal is recorded.

post.description: Text up to 2000 chars plus up to 5 photos. REFUSED (400 DELIVERY_CODE_IN_MESSAGE) when a six-digit group matches the deal's delivery code hash (D43). Contact details (email, phone) are detected and flagged on the message, never blocked. Read-only while a dispute is open and 14 days after the deal ends. One transaction: message + conversation timestamp + outbox event (D2).
